findings.evidence: Input/return full proof was outside the gate, but its following mandatory native presence query held the same wire gate and presence-query lane required by sent heartbeat replies. The check could consume the shared one-second operation budget.
findings.change: Move both full proof and mandatory writer presence before immediate gate admission; writer presence uses the restricted full-proof owner, independent of the sent heartbeat presence lane. Completed replies likewise check presence before TryLock. Contention discards proofs and rechecks.

findings.evidence: collectSourceInputThreads returned joined=false even after receiving all three native-owner outcomes when any outcome timestamp was later than its nominal deadline.
findings.change: Keep bounded waiting and drain queued completions on timer expiry; all observed exact completions prove join regardless of scheduling lateness. Missing owners and actual native cleanup errors remain failures.

findings.evidence: A heartbeat failure at 2026-10-31T09:23:54Z coincides with a retained runtime-summary timer-lateness maximum of 2457.263ms. Worker timing codes emitted on failure are maxima over a 15-second sample window, not stage measurements of the missing reply. Prior thread-join-low-level-hook means an owner was actually unobserved; the all-completions fix alone does not establish its resolution.

safety.unchanged: Fresh authority, exact command/sequence binding, no input replay, failure fencing, pinned handles until native return and exact child/job/thread retirement. Neither timeout nor process EOF certifies cleanup.

validation.test: Deployment runtime overlay: inputworker (22.742s), wininput (2.979s), inputdesktop, logindiag and localapi passed.
validation.regressions: Blocked input presence permits a real heartbeat ACK before input resumes; fresh presence is repeated after gate contention; existing generation/authority rejection, timeout handle retention, sequencing and retirement tests passed. Observed late completion accepted, missing owner rejected, real hook-release failure preserved.
validation.excludedTest: TestPortablePairRetainsIndependentRecoveryAfterInputFailure: live global portable recovery ownership prevented the initial fixture. Final suite explicitly excluded only this unrelated fixture; no ownership fence bypassed or live child killed.
validation.testDevelopment: Corrected a missing epoch in the new fixture and added synctest quiescence before an existing watchdog test inspected deferred slot release.
validation.frontend: 104/104 tests and native production build passed.
validation.package: Workspace package test passed (13.40s); 8-file archive, UI icon and installer checks passed; application setup offline verification passed.
validation.physicalCrossings: Pending user test; installation snapshot is not a recurrence or latency distribution.

limitations: Original Windows call or OS/process scheduling cause remains unconfirmed.
A genuine missing capture-thread completion still requires failure/recovery; no safe retirement receipt is invented.
Both control.previous.jsonl sources are incomplete; settled failure counts cover only the short retained post-install window.
